title: Public Alert No. 12/2025 – Recall of Batches of Regpara Tablets 25mg due to the presence of impurity
summary: NAFDAC relays DKSH Hong Kong Limited's precautionary recall of 10 batches of Regpara (cinacalcet) 25mg tablets due to N-nitroso-cinacalcet impurity above acceptable daily intake, a probable human carcinogen. The products are not in the NAFDAC database.
